title: Yellow Earthy Filipino Uni Pancit Bihon
description: A macrobiotic-friendly Filipino dish featuring uni, served as a dense and earthy one-pot pancit bihon, this recipe combines the freshness of the sea with the comfort of a traditional Filipino meal.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the uni and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the rice flour and stir to combine, cooking for 1 minute.
Add 2 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and sea salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
